## tmh enrollments list

List all enrollments

### Synopsis

Returns a list of the organization's enrollments. Filter by `status`, `courseId` or `archived`. Requires the `enrollments:read` scope.

--all follows every page, keeping the other flags, and prints all the items as one JSON array, so `| jq` works; add --ndjson to print one compact item per line as each page arrives.

Scopes: enrollments:read

```
tmh enrollments list [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --all                        follow every page and print all the items as one JSON array; --limit sets the page size
      --archived string            Archived; one of: true, false
      --course-id string           Course id
      --cursor nextCursor          The nextCursor from the previous page.
  -h, --help                       help for list
      --include priorCertificate   Opt-in enrichment. With priorCertificate, an item carries `priorCertificate` (object, or null when the server confirmed there is none). The key is omitted on an item whose answer is unknown, and on every item of the page if the certificate lookup failed; clients must treat a missing key as unknown, never as null; one of: priorCertificate
      --limit int                  How many objects to return, between 1 and 1000. Defaults to 20.
      --ndjson                     with --all, print one compact JSON item per line as each page arrives
      --status string              Filter on the derived effectiveStatus; one of: INVITED, EMAIL_BOUNCED, STARTED, ASSESSMENT_IN_PROGRESS, CERTIFIED, CANCELLED, EXPIRING, EXPIRED, ARCHIVED
```
